messages.body_plain:
Just a reminder (I think I sent to many calendar invites) we are now meeting on Wed.

Also, I got access to a big COVID-19 data set from John Hopkins.  So we have a new project, trying to make some sense of that.  We will talk a little bit about SQL queries from R.

(BTW, if anybody wants to do a session on SQL, that would be great!)

    --Russell
